# Not in the Book

*A traveller came through Brann's gate without appearing in Swithin's book. Hollis heard from a carter that a man like him was seen at the great waystone. Ask Hollis, go to the waystone and clear 30 monsters on the Waystone Meadows.*

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Hollis](../npcs/hollis.md)
2. Reach the great waystone in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
3. Defeat 30 monsters in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
